special_traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
special_traits.description:
If
the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It
can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (1d10
+ 8) Slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) Fire damage.

actions.name: DC 21, each creature in a 60-foot Cone
actions.description: Failure: 59 (17d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

legendary_actions.name: to cast Command (level 2 version)
legendary_actions.description: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Fiery Rays
legendary_actions.description:
The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray. The dragon can't take this action again until the
start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.description:
The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it
makes one Rend attack.
